answer_1.quote: we propose using text-to-text generation to accomplish the tasks of complaint identification, severity level classification, and cause extraction.
tasks: Other: Text-to-Text Generation for Multitask Complaint Analysis
answer_1.outputs: Generated sequences containing predictions for complaint identification, severity classification, emotion recognition, polarity recognition, and cause extraction.

answer_2.quote: The evaluation results further show that the proposed generative model consistently outperforms all other baselines and state-of-the-art models, in full and few-shot settings.

answer_4.quote: We also assess the linguistic aspect of the model by involving one expert in the English language, affiliated with the authors, who independently evaluated 100 generated causes from our models (ConC2D and FuseC2D).
answer_4.guideline: The evaluator rated the quality of the responses on a scale of 1 (worst), 3 (moderate), and 5 (best) using three predefined metrics: a) Fluency: The generated cause by the model should be syntactically or grammatically correct. b) Faithfulness: It measures the factual correctness of the cause with respect to the input tweet. c) Redundancy: It measures that the generated cause should not contain repeated information.
